description: F1 vectors for extras.atrium.behavior (scripting-4b-2). Read by the client copy (packages/behaviors/src/behavior-spec.js) and by the server copy (packages/server/src/send-policy.js), so the two cannot drift. `ownId` is the behaviour node's own object id; every accepted value must pass the rule AND validateInteractivityGraph, and every refused value must return the named code. scripting-4d round-2 R2 and R-L1 (a) add one event-entry rule (keys are `id` and optional `values`; an `atrium/*` entry is exactly `{ id }`) and one variable-entry rule (keys are `type` and optional `value`), and R3 pins `event/send`'s target check to the same predicate in both copies. scripting-4c AC2 adds `listensForSelect` (a stored leaf, and whether a click on it is something this world listens for) and `withinActivateDistance` (the 10 m rule); both copies of each rule read these two arrays. scripting-4d round-3 R9 / R-L3 (a) adds the string policy: an identifier (a socket map's key, or a `{ node, socket }` reference's name) is 1-64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_], a pointer is 1-256 characters of the pointer set, and every other string literal is prose of at most 256 characters with no control character but \n and \t and no U+2028/U+2029.
